title: Grusch's IG complaint and AOC exchange about reverse-engineering locations

tellings.quote: you know, he's uh provided, you know, hundreds of pages to the um you know, inspector general of the intelligence community, Thomas Mannheim to the effect that there are covert reverse engineering programs.

plain: A whistleblower named David Grusch is said to have handed hundreds of pages to Thomas Monheim, the Inspector General of the Intelligence Community, in a complaint filed in 2022. Michels says the pages argue that there are covert reverse engineering programs, meaning secret efforts to take apart recovered craft that are not of human make and learn how they work. He tells it himself, without naming a source, as background to a later exchange with Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez about where such programs are kept. If true, it would mean a formal complaint inside the intelligence world describes such hidden programs.
